intent_summary: Declared relationships require exact UTC timestamp alignment, shared cadence and entity scope, and compatible declared units.

criteria.criterion: Related datasets use identical normalized timestamps, the same declared cadence, and matching entity metadata.
Relationship sources are timestamped and have unique timestamps; implicit resampling and duplicate aggregation are not accepted for lineage.
Difference relationships require identical declared source units and matching output units.
An invalid relationship is reported as failed while valid sibling dataset results remain available.

verification_evidence: Primary Codex agent inspected every declared implementation reference and compared acceptance criteria with current source and test assertions; this is a fresh semantic review, completed in the existing session.
Read target errors/statuses and exact-alignment tests: timestamp/cadence/entity/unit mismatch or failed source yields a failed relationship while a healthy sibling remains available.
